meta.name: connectivity-usb-can
meta.description: USB and CAN connectivity for Zephyr RTOS. Covers USB device stack configuration (CDC ACM, HID, MSC), CAN controller integration, and professional USB-to-CAN adapter patterns including buffering and protocol packetization. Trigger when adding USB interfaces, implementing CAN bus communication, or building hardware diagnostic tools.

copy.tagline: 配置 Zephyr 的 USB 和 CAN 总线通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Zephyr RTOS 上开发 USB 或 CAN 通信功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure USB and CAN bus communication for Zephyr RTOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing USB or CAN communication on Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: 这个技能使Claude能够帮助你配置Zephyr RTOS的USB和CAN功能。它可以添加USB接口（如CDC ACM、HID、MSC），集成CAN控制器，并设计USB转CAN适配器模式，包括缓冲和协议分包。
howto.when: 当你需要添加USB接口、实现CAN总线通信或构建硬件诊断工具时，Claude会触发此技能提供配置和代码示例。

say.text: 帮我配置一个USB CDC ACM设备。
添加CAN控制器并设置硬件过滤器。
设计一个USB转CAN适配器固件。
say.note: Claude会指导实现缓冲和协议。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to help you configure USB and CAN functions for Zephyr RTOS. It can add USB interfaces (CDC ACM, HID, MSC), integrate CAN controllers, and design USB-to-CAN adapter patterns with buffering and protocol packetization.
howto.when_en: When you need to add USB interfaces, implement CAN bus communication, or build hardware diagnostic tools, Claude will use this skill to provide configuration and code examples.

say_en.text: Configure a USB CDC ACM device.
Add a CAN controller and set hardware filters.
say_en.note: Claude generates Kconfig and init code.
Claude guides on buffering and protocol.
